verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's own pages document concrete IP litigation experience, including patent cases before the UK Supreme Court (Unwired Planet), a precedent-setting FRAND/SEP win for Optis against Apple resulting in a $502M award, direct experience litigating before the Unified Patent Court, and brand/trademark enforcement and anti-counterfeiting work. These are specific venues (UK Supreme Court, UPC, Court of Appeal) and outcomes described on the firm's own service pages. Missing for 10: trade-secret-specific litigation examples and more granular outcome data (settlement figures, case counts) beyond the highlighted patent/FRAND matters.
